messages:
maya_pm: Quick sync — proposal for a small-batch, staggered design-partner intake + feedback loop. TL;DR: run 3 cohorts of 6 customers (6 weeks each, two-week overlap), weekly async feedback forms + one 60m live check-in per cohort. Need decisions on selection criteria, incentive structure, and launch gates.

priya_design: +1 to staggered cohorts. Smaller groups make it easier to iterate prompts and integrations quickly. Suggest we require a clear success use-case from partners (1–2 primary flows).

arun_eng: Two engineering asks: (1) we should cap model config variance per cohort so infra can predict token usage; (2) prefer rolling deploy windows so we can hotfix model rollouts without impacting all partners. :gear:

sam_research: For feedback cadence — weekly short forms + a single qualitative session sounds good. Proposal for metric set: task completion rate (per-flow), regression count vs baseline, partner qualitative score (1–5), and time-to-first-success. Would like a tiny prompt-eval harness tied to each cohort.

lia_prod_ops: Logistics/questions: who owns NDA + data handling for private partners? We should include a checkbox in intake for whether they need on-prem or can use hosted. Also propose a simple onboarding checklist.

maya_pm: Good points. Draft selection criteria (proposed):
```
- Must have a concrete integration plan (1 pager)
- 1-2 primary flows for evaluation (<= 5 prompts each)
- Team can commit 2-4 weekly hours to feedback
- Willingness to sign standard DP NDA + marketing opt-out option
- Technical contact with infra access for integration work
```
Thoughts?

priya_design: Add: diversity of latency/throughput needs (low-latency web vs batch embedding). Helps validate routing/batching settings. Also note: UX research will request 3 recorded sessions per cohort.

arun_eng: Regarding model config cap: propose we limit to these variants per cohort — {gpt-3.5-like, gpt-4-like, emb-quant}. That’s to keep autoscaling predictable. Also request sample token budget estimate in intake form.

sam_research: On success thresholds, propose launch gates:
- Acceptance: >= 70% task completion across primary flows
- No critical regressions (severity 1) for 2 consecutive weeks
- Partner retention intent >= 60% at week 4 (asked via pulse)
- Engineering: average P95 latency within target for partner tier
If thresholds met across any cohort, consider expanding to larger pilot.

lia_prod_ops: Incentives: tiered credit + implementation support. Example: 3 months free credits + 8 consulting hours for cohort 1, reduced for later cohorts. Also reimburse limited SRE time for on-prem partners. Need legal ack for credits.

maya_pm: Decision items for this week:
- Approve selection criteria (maya to finalize)
- Confirm cohort size 6 (ok?)
- Finalize incentive band (lia to propose numbers)
- Create intake form draft (lia + maya)
- Hook eval harness to onboarding template (sam + arun)

priya_design: cohort size 6 is good. For session rhythm: week 0 onboarding, week 1 baseline capture, weeks 2-5 iterative changes, week 6 wrap + NPS.

arun_eng: I'll add a config whitelist and token-budget field to the intake form. Also can we add an emergency rollback toggle in the DP config UI? bot-deploy might be able to enforce.

bot-deploy: deploy plan note: we can gate rollouts by cohort tag and provide a one-click rollback label. Need feature flag ticket (ENG-4087).

sam_research: I'll draft the weekly form (3 quick metrics + 2 open questions) and link eval harness snippets (prompt sets + sample payload) so feedback is consistent across partners.

maya_pm: Nice. I'll compile decisions and create a short intake doc + slack post to start recruiting. Target: first cohort onboarding in 4 weeks. If anyone has partner leads, DM me. :raised_hands:

priya_design: DMing a healthcare contact who might need private deploy. They require PHI guardrails — include that in intake.

lia_prod_ops: Noted — add "PHI/PII scope" checkbox. Also planning: onboarding checklist that includes security review timeline (2 weeks).

maya_pm: Perfect. Thanks all — will post summary and next steps.
